when to use redis vs postgres

Quick thread 🧵
**Redis vs Postgres** is the wrong framing for most apps.
Postgres is your durable source of truth: ACID, joins, the data you can't afford to lose.
Redis is a fast in-memory layer for caching, sessions, rate limits, and queues.
Small apps often need only Postgres on day one.
